title: Covenant breach under the downside scenario, with change-of-control acceleration
thresholds_source: docs/decisions/risk-thresholds.md — D-M-RISK-2 + AI-1 (chair ruling carrying the risk-officer dissent); activated by ADR-0057
notes: risk-thresholds.md AI-1 (risk-officer dissent on D-M-RISK-2, carried by chair ruling). Deliberately over-inclusive in the halt direction: risk.covenants_breached counts ALL breached covenant tests of the latest simulation (the mandatory ma-11 +200bp rate-shock downside run), because covenant type / CoC-acceleration membership is indistinguishable in current evidence (debt_instrument.covenant_json is free TEXT, no type column - D-M-RISK-2 defers type semantics for cause). A halt routes the case to the human gate, where the CoC question is asked directly; narrowing the predicate requires covenant-type schema (first-recalibration agenda, AI-3). Activated by ADR-0057 together with the db/lib/kill-criteria.ts evaluator: enabled=true with policy_id + thresholds_source satisfies the anti-tamper gate (registry check c), and the evaluator enforces the same gate at runtime. Classification (ADR-0060): class (i) — var exists and threshold decided; already expressed and enabled (ADR-0057; risk.covenants_breached, D-M-RISK-2 + AI-1, anchor gd-0022-risk-thresholds).
